# Regression and Generalised Linear Modelling

> Fit linear, logistic and count models that answer a stated question, check them by simulating from the fit, and report effects with intervals people can read. SDAIA Academy course DS-301, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 18,793 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Linear models that answer a question](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day1.md): Three uses, fake data, splines and an interaction, ending with marginal effects in cubic metres; sessions: A regression answers a question, Fake data first, Transformations and splines, Interactions and marginal effects; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day1.html; about 4,771 tokens
- [Day 2: Generalised linear models](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day2.md): Families and links: late payment on the probability scale, leaks on the count scale; sessions: Links and families, Reading a logistic model, Counts and exposure, Overdispersion; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day2.html; about 3,917 tokens
- [Day 3: Check and repair](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day3.md): Five seeded problems in a previous analyst's models, found and repaired; sessions: Residuals that tell you something, Influential observations, Simulation-based checks, Separation and error structure; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day3.html; about 4,262 tokens
- [Day 4: Grouped data and many predictors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day4.md): Districts of very different sizes, 120 candidate predictors, and a report people can read; sessions: Clustered data, Partial pooling, Penalised regression, Reporting a model; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/day4.html; about 4,379 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone project presentations](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/capstone.md): An eight-minute defence of a regression analysis, then four minutes of questions; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/slides/capstone.html; about 902 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Three uses of a regression](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D1_1_three_uses.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Fake data first](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D1_2_fake_data.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: A temperature spline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D1_3_temperature_spline.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Interaction and marginal effects](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D1_4_interaction_effects.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Linear against logistic](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D2_1_linear_vs_logistic.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Three household profiles](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D2_2_three_profiles.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Leaks with an exposure](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D2_3_poisson_offset.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Dispersion and the negative binomial](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D2_4_negative_binomial.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Binned residuals](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D3_1_binned_residuals.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Influential districts](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D3_2_influential_districts.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: The share of zeros](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D3_3_share_of_zeros.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Separation and robust errors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D3_4_separation_hc.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: Clustered standard errors](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D4_1_clustered_errors.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Partial pooling](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D4_2_partial_pooling.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Ridge and lasso](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D4_3_ridge_lasso.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: A one-page model report](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-301/labs/D4_4_model_report.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
